guide.name: Calendly OAuth Setup Guide
guide.summary: Connect Calendly accounts to read scheduled events
guide.timeNote: Planning estimate, not a measured setup duration. Assuming existing OAuth callback and development environment

steps.title: Create OAuth App
steps.detail: Log in to Calendly, go to Developer tools, and select Create OAuth app. Enter app details, including redirect URI and environment type. Select Next and choose required scopes, including scheduled_events:read. (Source: s4)

steps.title: Configure Redirect URI
steps.detail: Set redirect URI to HTTPS for production or http://localhost:1234/callback for sandbox. Ensure the redirect URI matches the one registered in the OAuth app. (Source: s4)

steps.title: Implement PKCE
steps.detail: Use Proof Key for Code Exchange (PKCE) with the S256 method to authorize users. Generate a code challenge and verifier, and include them in the authorization request. (Source: s4)

steps.title: Get Authorization Code
steps.detail: Redirect the user to Calendly's authorization page, including client ID, redirect URI, and code challenge. Handle the authorization code redirect and exchange it for an access token. (Source: s4)

steps.title: Exchange Code for Access Token
steps.detail: Send a POST request to Get Access Token, including grant type, redirect URI, client ID, and code verifier. Handle the access token response and store it securely. (Source: s4)

steps.title: Test Consent Flow
steps.detail: Test the consent flow with a Calendly user, ensuring the correct scopes are requested and granted. Verify the access token has the required scopes. (Source: s5)

steps.title: Confirm readiness before external launch
steps.detail: Confirm the intended app type, allowed scopes, and any unresolved provider review requirements with the provider before external rollout. If the cited documentation does not settle eligibility, send provider support your audience, planned actions, and exact scopes. Submit a review only if the provider confirms it is required; do not promise a launch date while this is unresolved.

blockers.title: Missing Scope Error
blockers.detail: Verify scopes requested during installation include all required by the endpoint. Reauthorize the app if necessary. (Source: s5)
blockers.resolution: Reauthorize the app or update the scopes requested during installation.

blockers.title: Webhooks Not Delivering Events
blockers.detail: Ensure related domain read scopes are granted. Update the scopes requested during installation if necessary. (Source: s5)
blockers.resolution: Update the scopes requested during installation to include the required read scopes.

blockers.title: Public App Mode Authorization
blockers.detail: Unknown who can authorize public app mode. Investigate and clarify the authorization process for public app mode. (Source: unknown)
blockers.resolution: Investigate and clarify the authorization process for public app mode.

blockers.title: Production Launch Approval
